method: Read-only inspection of the installed binary and native CUA comparison at display scale 2. No Arc process instrumentation.

nativeObservation.note: Arc positions are read from the native screenshot; Zen values are independently measured after opening animation in an owned headless profile.

limits: Only horizontal Downloads list alignment is corrected.
Exact search-field alignment, glyph rasterization, row hover shapes and animation parity remain unverified.
Normal installed Zen download previews remain affected by the macOS Downloads-folder code requirement mismatch; this CSS change does not resolve file access.
No whole-browser performance gain is claimed.
